text:
lina: Quick alert 126: saw repeated p99 spikes on marketplace GPU images after upstream driver 538.x rolled into our image build. Symptoms: long memcpy stalls on multi-GPU pipelines.

devon: Is it repro on our lab images? which SKUs?

lina: Repro on g6x and a100-40gb with long-context generation (32k). Log snippet: 'memcpy stalled 250ms, NVML GPU-Util 99%'.

marco: Suggest immediate image rollback/pin to last known-good driver 528.77 for affected SKUs and open partner ticket. Erin can coordinate the marketplace pin.

erin (Marketplace): Will do. Plan: pin canary AMI to driver 528.77, run cross-device canary at 5% traffic, monitor p95/p99 for 2h, then promote. Tag: marketplace:2026-03-27-pin-528.

pat (HWPartner): We've seen a similar signal in our internal lab. Opening HW ticket HP-2096. Early hypothesis: a change in the peer-copy batching path in 538 causes extra syncs under certain fragmented transfer sizes. We'll share kernel traces in ticket.

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-canary] failed 4140000101 \u2014 case "gen-32k-batch-4" \u2014 p99 +40% vs baseline.

devon: OK canary pin + advisory. Erin please draft a short customer note: affected configs, mitigation (use pinned image or fallback to single-GPU), ETA for partner patch.

erin (Marketplace): Draft posted to docs: https://docs.internal/marketplace/advisories/528-pin-2026-03-27.md \u2014 sharing for review.

pat (HWPartner): Ticket updated with traces. If it's the batching path we can provide a micro-patch; ETA 48-72h for validated backport.

marco: Nice. Once partner patch is available we'll validate in staging and coordinate a rolling update. Keeping thread for coordination.

ci-bot: [job:redwood/marketplace-canary] passed 4140000500 after pin applied \u2014 p99 within 5% of baseline.

erin (Marketplace): Canary shows improvement. Promoting to 25% in 15m. Will keep customers informed.

lina: Thanks team. Filing follow-ups: infra PR infra/marketplace-image#901, partner ticket HP-2096, advisory link above.
